description.label: Description
description.value: You strike blows with such focus and force that it breaks armor and pulps flesh as it strikes. When using a single-handed melee weapon with two hands to make a single melee attack, you add +1 Strength Bonus to the attack. Any Melee (Two-handed) weapon with the Hack or Pummel Quality may also count as having the Impact Quality for a number of attacks equal to your level of Hammer Swing per day, to represent the shocking force of your blow’s impacts. Any attack made using the Impact Quality in this manner after expending your daily uses requires a Very Hard (-30) Endurance Test. If failed, you receive one @Condition[Fatigued] Condition.
